name: @agentkib/desktop
description: Desktop app for discovering, diagnosing, and synchronizing coding agent configuration.
author: AgentKib contributors

scripts.dev:electron: pnpm protocol:generate && pnpm quota:prepare && pnpm quota:stage && pnpm runtime:build:dev && pnpm electron:build && concurrently -k -n renderer,electron "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:1420 && cross-env AGENTKIB_DEV=1 VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1420 electron dist-electron/main.cjs"
scripts.build:electron: pnpm protocol:generate && pnpm runtime:build && pnpm runtime:stage && pnpm build:web && pnpm electron:build
scripts.electron:build: vite build --config vite.main.config.ts && vite build --config vite.preload.config.ts
scripts.dist:electron: pnpm protocol:generate && pnpm runtime:build && pnpm quota:prepare && pnpm runtime:stage && pnpm build:web && pnpm electron:build && electron-builder
scripts.forge:stage: node scripts/stage-forge-resources.mjs && node scripts/stage-forge-app.mjs && pnpm --config.node-linker=hoisted --dir build/forge-app install --ignore-workspace --lockfile=false
scripts.forge:prepare: pnpm protocol:generate && pnpm runtime:build && pnpm quota:prepare && pnpm runtime:stage && pnpm build:web && pnpm electron:build && pnpm forge:stage
scripts.forge:package: pnpm forge:prepare && cross-env "npm_config_hoist_pattern=*" electron-forge package build/forge-app
scripts.forge:make: pnpm forge:prepare && pnpm forge:makers:prepare && cross-env "npm_config_hoist_pattern=*" electron-forge make build/forge-app
